import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { inventory } from "../../../backend/schema/inventory";

export const inventoryCms = customizeTable<typeof inventory>("inventory", {
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["inventoryId", "lastUpdate", "film", "store"]
});
